sections.h2: UP's EV subsidy approvals rose 241% in FY2025-26 after a dip in FY2024-25

chart.title: Approvals dipped in FY2024-25, then reached 47,514 in FY2025-26
chart.sub: EV subsidy applications approved, per financial year.
chart.source: UP EV Subsidy Portal; Free Press Journal.

sections.means: Approvals ran at 15,091, then 13,950, before the FY2025-26 surge to 47,514.
sections.todo: Publish a running scoreboard for the manufacturing and jobs side, as the portal already does for buyer subsidies.

sections.h2: Haryana's cluster programme has built 30 of 100 targeted pack-houses this year

chart.title: Only 30 of 100 pack-houses are built, with 35 still in progress
chart.sub: Crop Cluster Development Programme, pack-houses this fiscal year, count.
chart.source: Haryana CCDP figures, as reported in the article.

sections.means: Thirty pack-houses are built against a target of 100 for this fiscal year, with 35 under way.
sections.todo: Report in-year targets against built counts for every linkage scheme, rather than only at year end.

sections.h2: Karnataka cut its 2024-25 excise estimate from the budget figure mid-year

chart.title: The 2024-25 excise target was revised down mid-year to ₹36,500 crore
chart.sub: Karnataka excise revenue, ₹ crore: original budget versus revised estimate for 2024-25.
chart.source: Karnataka budget documents; PRS Legislative Research.

sections.means: The original budget of ₹38,525 crore was cut to a ₹36,500 crore revised estimate.
sections.todo: Judge excise performance by the year-on-year collection trend, not by the announced target.
